title: Multi-floor generalization of TASEP
summary: We consider an interacting particle system, which generalizes the classical totally asymmetric simple exclusion process (TASEP), in that each site can contain up to a fixed finite number of particles, and the particle movement is governed by a {\em back-pressure} (BP) algorithm (also often called {\em MaxWeight}). There are $N$ sites (with $N$ finite or infinite), each may contain at most $c$ particles, $1 \le c 1$.
